recap.text: Last time, a zombie climbed down my rope. So I kicked the window.

land.text: Floor ten. I'm inside. I'm alive.

bad.text: Bad news. The hallway is packed with zombies.

hose.text: But at the end of that hallway... a fire hose. A very long fire hose.

r1.text: Rule one. Don't make a sound.

r2.text: Rule two. Don't step on anything.

stop.text: Why did the phone go quiet?

end.text: Part three. Follow, and tell my mom I'm fine.

momA.text: Honey? It's your mother. Are you eating enough?
